## 4c. Lat Pulldown

Exercise Objective: Develop strength in the muscles of the upper back

## Start Position

1. Adjust the thigh pad to anchor the body to the seat
2. Place hands evenly on the bar, slightly wider than shoulderwidth, with a pronated grip
3. Fully extend arms, keep chest up, back flat, and engage the core (-34)

## Procedure

1. Keep back flat, pull shoulder blades down and back while flexing elbows
2. Pull the bar down until it touches the top of the chest (-35)
3. Return the bar to the start position in a slow, controlled manner

## Coaching Points
